name: 21137-fixedlen-3b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of an a3 node (--gres=gpu:1).
architecture: Dense Llama-3 decoder, 3.2B parameters, 28 layers, GQA with 24 query heads over 8 KV heads, head_dim 128, bf16.
workload: synthetic_text, single turn, fixed 256 prompt tokens and 128 output tokens, no variance; random text, so no two requests share a prefix by construction.
purpose: A 3B-parameter chat assistant answering 16 concurrent users with uniform short prompts and brief replies on one GPU.
launch:
# Launch config for 21137-fixedlen-3b-1gpu.
# Engine: commit 526078a96c52af678a1ddbdc3ecf78265e358f2b, built from source (see configs/env.yaml).

# `meta-llama/Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct` is what the source benchmarked; `unsloth/Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct`
# is an ungated mirror of the same checkpoint (Llama 3.2 Community License) -- LlamaForCausalLM,
# 28 layers, 24 query heads over 8 KV heads, head_dim 128,
# hidden 3072, tied embeddings, bf16, max_position_embeddings 131072. The 131072 is load-bearing:
# it is what makes PRE's block-table mask 8192 columns wide.
model: unsloth/Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct
tensor-parallel-size: 1

# Pinned, not defaults: unpinned these fall through to much smaller SchedulerConfig values.
max-num-seqs: 1024
max-num-batched-tokens: 16384

# The attention backend is not an engine argument at this commit -- it is read only from
# VLLM_ATTENTION_BACKEND, so it is applied from configs/tuned.yaml instead of here.
